{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Immigration enforcement must be humane and consistent with values.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Prioritization in immigration enforcement should be given to those who pose a threat to the safety of communities, not hardworking families contributing to their communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Raids and roundups of children and families will be ended.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Deportations of immigrants who served in the armed forces are disfavored.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A faster path to citizenship will be created for veterans who served in the armed forces.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Due process should be ensured for those fleeing violence in Central America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Work should be done with regional partners to address the root causes of violence in Central America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Particular care should be taken with children fleeing violence in Central America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Government-funded counsel should be guaranteed for unaccompanied children in immigration courts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"All available means of protecting individuals fleeing violence should be considered, including strengthening in-country and third-country processing, expanding the use of humanitarian parole, and granting Temporary Protected Status.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
